item.title: La Cygne police department utilizes latest technology
item.description: To increase officer and public safety, responsibly utilize grant funding, and stay current with modern investigative tactics, the La Cygne Police Department has purchased a “Narc Ranger” spectrometer used in the identification of illicit substances. item.title: Harrisonville Rotary Young Professional of the Month
item.description: Congratulations to Pepin Bray, CCC’s Rotary Club Young Professional of the Month for March! Pepin, a home-schooled senior, serves as a Captain in our EMT Academy and senior leader in the CCC Fire Science Program, is a state-level competitor in SkillsUSA Missouri, and is a member of the National Technical Honor Society. item.description: It is with deep sorrow that we announce the passing of James "Jim" Mark Woodward, age 79, who departed this life on Thursday, March 5, 2026, at Research Medical Center in Kansas City, Missouri. item.title: Obituary - Richard Lewis Mitchell

item.title: Obituary - Marvin Preston Hutchens
item.description: Marvin Preston Hutchens, age 79, of Warsaw, Missouri, departed this life on Thursday, March 5, 2026, at his home in Warsaw, Missouri.Marvin was born on August 31, 1946, in Harrisonville, Missouri, the son of Preston and Ada Hutchens. He grew up in the Harrisonville area and, following high school, proudly served his country in the United States Army from 1966 to 1969.On October 28, 1967, Marvin was united in marriage to Nancy Joe Craycraft at the First Baptist Church in Harrisonville, Missouri.
